codeReview.summary: The fix correctly addresses the live booking-entry crash by removing the server-to-client Lucide component serialization from the loading boundary. The updated loading surface remains guest-owned and accessible, and the widened GuestStatus icon typing matches current usage without introducing an obvious regression in the reviewed scope.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The guest-ui-worker skill requires a RED test-first step, but this runtime-only regression was diagnosed primarily through live browser/curl reproduction because existing targeted tests were already green. The skill should clarify that reproducing a live-only failure before adjusting coverage is acceptable when automated tests do not expose the bug.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission library documents canonical guest routes and shell primitives, but it does not currently capture the React Server Component limitation that passing Lucide component constructors through server/client guest loading boundaries can trigger serialization crashes. This runtime quirk was central to the fix and would be useful shared knowledge for later guest UI workers.
